name: reqif.import
title: Import ReqIF file
summary: Import a ReqIF 1.2 file through a saved mapping, all or nothing: one element per object, with the losses reported. A repeated delivery of the same source updates the elements of the earlier one.
details: Each element keeps its origin (source, source IDENTIFIER, import date, delivery, import version), which no other command writes. A repeated delivery updates the elements of the earlier one in place (matched by source and source IDENTIFIER) and only lists the dropped ones; an element changed locally and in the delivery is a conflict that needs take or keep, else the import is refused (reqif.conflict).
whileReadOnlyReason: Creates and changes elements, and no change can be checked against a missing or faulty metamodel.

delivery.description: Name of the delivery, written to the origin of each element it imports or updates.

mapping.description: Needed unless the file comes from ReqSeq (REQ-IF-TOOL-ID reqseq), which is mapped one to one.

source.description: Source name for a file of ReqSeq without mapping; default the header TITLE.

take.description: Conflicts for which the delivery is taken: an exact source IDENTIFIER, else an element among the conflicts.

keep.description: Conflicts for which the local element is kept: an exact source IDENTIFIER, else an element among the conflicts.

updated.description: Elements of an earlier delivery the delivery was written into (changed, taken, or a title, property or relation that differed).

kept.description: Conflicts in keep: content left, only the origin written.

dropped.description: Elements of the source whose object the file no longer has; not changed.

items.description: Written file, relative to the workspace root.
